subject: R was not built as a shared library - cents 6

messages.author: db3e727b0ff852e7
messages.subject: R was not built as a shared library - cents 6
parts:
Hi,
I am trying install rapache on centos 6 and am running into this error
(which I understand is common):
------------
R was not built as a shared library

Either build it with one, or use another install of R
--------------

I installed R from the epel repository here: http://dl.fedoraproject.org/pub/epel/6/x86_64/

the build log for their R-devel RPM says that it was build as a shared
library (http://kojipkgs.fedoraproject.org/packages/R/2.15.0/1.el6/
data/logs/x86_64/build.log)
--enable-R-shlib

I have also installed httpd-devel from the same repository
Here is my apache version info:
[root@localhost ~]# httpd -version
Server version: Apache/2.2.15 (Unix)
Server built: Feb 13 2012 22:31:42

When I run ./configure I use this command:
./configure --with-R=/usr/lib64/R --with-apache2-apxs=/usr/sbin/apxs

I do not see apxs2 on the machine, so I assume /usr/sbin/apxs is ok?

I contacted the epel repository people first and after pointing me to
the build.log to confirm that R was built as a shared library, they
told me I should contact the "Rapache" folks. Thanks for any help you
might be able to provide.

Brian

messages.author: 3ea57457192f4f3b
messages.subject: Re: R was not built as a shared library - cents 6
parts:
On Monday, June 4, 2012 5:59:27 PM UTC+2, bbolt wrote:
Hi,
I am trying install rapache on centos 6 and am running into this error
(which I understand is common):
------------
R was not built as a shared library

Either build it with one, or use another install of R
--------------

I had this problem as well today on Fedora 20. The problem turned out to be that 'make' was not installed. Therefore in configure, the line:

R CMD config --ldflags 

fails, unfortunately with the wrong error message. Simply installing make solved the problem in my case.
